design_frozen.arms: identical construction to E-Q20b: A1 mulberry32(20261018+k) n=20, A3 tau-from-comet-expanded + sealed blur grids n=5, A3S the ONE fixed permutation n=5. A2 excluded (inherited).

design_frozen.floors: F0'' the ON-gate: with wormholes ON the harness must reproduce E-Q20b's sealed values byte-exactly (hashes at t=512, floor table, cross-arm medians) — run BEFORE the OFF arm, a mismatch VOIDS LOUD; F-m1 the manipulation check: twinRate == 0 at every checkpoint under OFF (any nonzero twin event = the OFF arm is not OFF, VOID); F-m2 determinism: full journal replay x2 byte-identical under OFF.
design_frozen.metrics: same as E-Q20b: Moore-8 Moran's I distance (primary), dW1/tauTV/twinRate (controls; twinRate expected 0 by F-m1). Floor = A1 LOO 95th pct nearest-rank per checkpoint (computed within the OFF run).

hypotheses.H1c: the twin channel carries (part of) the memory: OFF plateau ratio (mean over t in {256,320,384,448,512} of A3 median-distance / floor) is at least 15% BELOW the ON ratio (0.2049 from the sealed E-Q20b table — recomputed, not transcribed).
hypotheses.H0c: the reservoir is local: OFF ratio within the plane-bootstrap 95% CI of the ON ratio (bootstrap: resample the 5 A3 planes' per-plane distances with replacement, 2000 draws).
hypotheses.secondary: the A3S upward excursion structure (0.0687@16 ON) — does it survive OFF? Reported AS-SAID with the same ratio comparison.

design_frozen.verdict_rules: H1c evaluated on the primary metric only, ON values from the sealed e_q20b_results.json re-derived by the F0'' gate. If H1c and H0c disagree in direction, H1c wins (the registered primary); a result between the 15% line and the CI edge is receipted as INCONCLUSIVE-BY-DESIGN (the two thresholds are deliberately different instruments).

falsifier: ANY of: F0'' mismatch; a nonzero twinRate under OFF; determinism disagreement; a checkpoint row written before F0'' and F-m1 pass.
